correctness.rationale: With the explicitly listed 12-vertex, 30-edge icosahedral graph, F_d consists of induced forests of maximum internal degree <=d. A vertex neighborhood is a 5-cycle, so a forest cannot contain three neighbors of a vertex, proving saturation F_d=F_2 for d>=2. Independent enumeration of all 4096 masks per level found nonempty face totals 68,323,983 and mod-two Betti ranks beta_1=6,beta_2=1 at d0; beta_3=20 at d1; beta_4=40 at d2. At d0, 20 triangles with 30 shared edges and links cycles give sphere surface, with six extra 1-cell attachments. Separately parsed pinned CERTIFICATE.json and reconstructed every degree-0/1/2 face, all 29/147/471 matching pairs, 132/972/3972 Hasse covers, and complete acyclic topological sorts; critical counts are d1 one 0-cell, four 2-cells, 24 3-cells and d2 one 0-cell, forty 4-cells. Fresh signed Morse reduction for d1 matched all 24 stored columns and recovered exact 4x4 minor determinant +1, cancelling four 2-cells integrally and leaving 20 three-spheres. Zero degree overlaps across stages establish precise integer persistence bars. These are exhaustive checks of fixed finite graph, not general forests.
residual_risks: Unimodular matrix argument and acyclic matching prove homotopy only for this explicit icosahedral graph; no functorial equivalence between distinct stages is claimed.
